notes: The diagram's upper breadboard half (rows j-f, columns 3, 6, 8) is mapped to the catalogue's 't' bank (rows a-e). Image row i is 'b', row h is 'c' and row g is 'd'. Only the column strip matters electrically.

The green wire goes from board pin 2 to column 3. The resistor spans columns 3 to 6. The LED's bent (longer) leg is in column 6 and is the anode. The other leg is in column 8 and is the cathode. The black wire joins column 8 to GND.
The manual lists a 220 ohm resistor, but the catalogue part is a generic resistor. I set value=220.
The schematic shows D2 -> resistor -> LED anode, then LED cathode -> GND. This matches the breadboard image.
The board is not placed on the breadboard. It connects only through the two jumper wires.
The sketch reads A1, but nothing is connected to it.
